name: Sales Meeting Desk
permissionsNotice: Bot Cabinet generates plans and packages. Hermes Desktop settings and connected-service permissions are applied by you. Passports are checklists, not locks.

members.name: Scout
members.responsibility: Gather current public information about the prospect.
requestedCapabilities: Optional read-only access to an approved source list
approvalActions: A person selects the topics to pursue
A person verifies important claims against the linked sources before publication
members.firstTest: Review five approved sources and return three ideas with working links.

members.name: Researcher
members.responsibility: Verify account facts and separate evidence from assumptions.
requestedCapabilities: Read-only document access when I provide files
approvalActions: A person makes legal, medical, financial, and policy decisions
members.firstTest: Answer one narrow question using at least three approved sources and identify any unresolved conflict.

members.name: Planner
members.responsibility: Build the meeting objective, question sequence, and decision points.
approvalActions: Ask before assigning people or committing dates
Ask before changing an external task system
A person approves assignments and deadlines
members.firstTest: Create a two-week plan from one approved objective and identify every missing decision.

members.name: Client Deliverables
members.responsibility: Turn approved notes into a recap and follow-up draft.
approvalActions: Ask before including prices, promises, or deadlines
A person approves pricing, promises, and final delivery
A person limits client information to approved files and systems and checks the Bot’s access before use
members.firstTest: Create a two-page client update from supplied notes and mark every item that needs approval.

members.name: Editor
members.responsibility: Check accuracy and flag unsupported promises.
requestedCapabilities: Optional web access for checking supplied links
members.firstTest: Edit a two-page memo and explain the five most important changes.

handoffOrder.action: Research the account and approve the objective.
Extract decisions, commitments, and open questions.
Review and send the approved recap or proposal.

approvalActions: Change pricing, scope, terms, or opportunity stage
Promise a delivery date or result
